Survey Events is a main Study Area tab after Analysis, which also
provides a Continue to Survey Events button. The panel uses
native choice lists populated from saved Survey Collections and their date evidence.
Known same-month collections form a suggestion; unresolved dates remain explicit.
The definition modal prefills those collections, known year/month and Streams with
saved DEM choices (or the sole Stream). Output cell size still requires an explicit
analyst choice. No blank saved-event selector is shown when none exist. Saved
Survey Events use a short date dropdown above the DEM. Event Settings contains
the selected event's details and Review / edit Survey Event button. Creation
controls and acquisition evidence are grouped separately in Define a Survey Event
in the top panel, collapsed when saved events exist and expanded for the first event.
Cancel discards the editor; Save Survey Event validates and publishes a snapshot.
Opening an editor marks pending work for the existing study lifecycle guard.

"Acquisition group" remains an internal legacy API/storage name only. It must not
be presented as a separate analyst concept. Saving the local Survey Event definition
does not create FGDB Reach Event records. Saving updates the context used by automatic mask preparation and the Stream DEM queue described in article 13.

`mod_study_server()` mounts `survey_event_settings_server()` with
the current study, saved selection path and a pending-selection callback. The
editor reads persisted selections, not unsaved search results. Proposals come from
`fluvgeo::propose_survey_acquisition_groups()`. Using a proposal fills collection
membership and year/month; the analyst still chooses Streams, enters output cell
size. No membership/date rationale field is presented or required to save.
Provider evidence is retained automatically; editing preserves older analyst notes.
Ambiguous dates still require an explicit year and month/precision choice.

The store's `save_acquisition_group()` compares expected context, selection and
group revision paths and rejects duplicate Reach Event links across groups.
`fluvgeo::write_survey_acquisition_group()` owns validation, UUID identity, CRS
units, saved grid alignment, evidence tables and non-replacing publication.
The store reads `acquisition-group-NNNNNN.gpkg` revisions and keeps the latest
snapshot per UUID for display. Existing group edits retain the UUID. Dates are
labels with explicit year/month precision, never identity keys.

Existing Reach Events may be linked explicitly; no Reach Event is manufactured
from a group date label. The immutable records retain Stream IDs for future
products. The settings writer saves metadata; the module then starts automatic
mask preparation as described in [article 12](dev-12-event-masks.html). Collection
choices, downloads, CRS definitions, source assets and hierarchy contexts are
retained. Changed selection/CRS evidence is marked for review. The implementation
currently aligns cells to (0, 0) within the saved real-world CRS; this particular
initial alignment convention is not author-confirmed. Do not silently move saved
grids. Future DEM assembly still needs source compatibility and grid qualification.

Tests: `tests/testthat/test-survey-event-settings.R` covers adapter revision and
Shiny state transitions; sibling fluvgeo's `test_survey_acquisition_groups.R`
covers conservative date evidence. The backend schema is
`fluvgeo/dev/schemas/survey-acquisition-groups.md`. No service calls or analyst
studies are test fixtures.

The current top panel includes both existing Event selection and the collapsed
creation section, so first-time setup starts at the top of the page. After selection,
`survey_event_dems_server()` (article 13) presents the assigned Stream queue and
result tabs. The earlier single-DEM development panel is no longer the normal flow.

## Data objects and storage

See [Data objects and local storage](storage-model.html) for the FGDB ownership and physical representation crosswalk.

| Operation | Data object read or changed | Physical representation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Propose/read Event definition | Reads acquisition dates, hierarchy and selected sources | GeoPackage context and Survey Collection records |
| `write_survey_acquisition_group()` | Saves app acquisition membership, Stream assignments, grid settings and existing Event links | GeoPackage `settings`, `members`, `streams` ID list and `event_links` |
| Context Event reader | Reads existing Reach Survey Events | GeoPackage `survey_events`, keyed by Event ID and Reach parent ID |

The app definition coordinates source preparation across Streams. It is not a new
FGDB hierarchy level and does not create the linked Reach Survey Event rows.
The governing Event identity/date contract remains FGDB's Reach-owned Survey Event.
